meta.title: Container management plugin
meta.description: This plugin manages existing containers through the host’s installed `docker` CLI, providing listing, concise inspect, logs, start/stop/restart and a single statistics sample. It brings no Docker SDK, no bundled runtime and no direct daemon socket (G-05 / G-17): every external action is a fixed-argv `docker` subprocess (no shell). A missing docker CLI, unreachable daemon or non-Linux platform returns `E_UNSUPPORTED`, with no silent fallback and no fabricated data.
